title: Anthropic pitches AI safety bill that may block a model if 50+ people could be killed
snippet: The proposed policy seems to offer protections against AI running amok but actually forbids federal agencies from blocking a model's release without the permission of a judge.

title: SpaceX and Tesla boards form special committees to review merger
snippet: Elon Musk likes the idea but says he is not on either committee, which is made up of independent directors.

title: Hugging Face CEO warns that Netflix’s OpenAI hack documentary isn’t accurate
snippet: Before you share the Netflix documentary "AI Gone Rogue," take note. Clem Delangue, Hugging Face's co-founder who is featured in the film, says it went "full doomer mode" and isn't accurate.
